title: Van Kampen diagrams
description: Van Kampen diagrams without topology: plane maps and their operations, free groups, presentations and Cayley graphs, and van Kampen's lemma in three parts; the foundation for the diagram arguments of the courses on irrational traces, the Kadison-Kaplansky conjecture and reduced Baum-Connes injectivity.

units.title: Words, free groups and Cayley graphs

prerequisites: programme course Barnette's conjecture (barnettes-conjecture): lesson Sphere maps (Definition 1.1, Lemma 1.2, Example 1.3, Lemma 1.4, Lemma 1.5, Proposition 1.6, Lemma 2.1, Lemma 3.1, Theorem 3.2, Lemma 3.4, Proposition 3.5, Section 4 and Proposition 4.1)
